name: Ish-bosheth
summary: A son of Saul whom Abner made king over Israel after Saul's death, while Judah followed David. He reigned two years before two of his own captains killed him in his bed.

key_moments.title: Made King by Abner
key_moments.description: Abner took Saul's son Ish-bosheth to Mahanaim and made him king over Israel. He was forty years old and reigned two years, but the house of Judah followed David.

key_moments.title: Accuses Abner over Rizpah
key_moments.description: Ish-bosheth accused Abner over Saul's concubine Rizpah. Abner was furious and swore to give the kingdom to David, and Ish-bosheth was too afraid to answer him.

key_moments.title: Killed in His Bed
key_moments.description: Rechab and Baanah came to his house at noon, killed Ish-bosheth on his bed and brought his head to David at Hebron. David had them put to death and buried the head in the grave of Abner.
